revision.selectedEditPrompt: Edit this asset for a medieval manuscript miniature composited directly over an existing parchment page. Retain the slender gently S-curving slit and seven discreet rust-red silk stitches with paired tiny needle holes. REMOVE ALL surrounding parchment strip, tan fibrous patches, torn exterior silhouette, tan shading, pale glow, vignette, ambient halo, and background. The only visible pixels should be the very narrow irregular dark slit (fine hairline closed with stitches), tiny locally raised slit lips, fourteen tiny needle holes, and the seven red thread bridges; isolated on fully transparent background. No second sheet or patch. Slit lips are no wider than a stitch thickness, subtly warm brown with restrained ink-like shadow, no white outline. Elegant tiny materially convincing hand-drawn medieval miniature, fine fiber twist and natural variable thread tension, not a large surgical wound. Keep vertical centered composition. This is an original manuscript repair illustration, not text. Absolutely no broad parchment-colored region and no luminous halo.

prompts.paper: Create one original, completely blank sheet of aged animal-skin parchment for a finely made contemporary keepsake inspired by European medieval manuscript materials. Flat material asset, not a scene. Entire single sheet completely flat, straight from above, orthographic, every edge visible, no perspective. Portrait proportions approximately 5:7 intended for a 2048 by 2868 document. Sheet occupies about 94 percent of image width and height, narrow fully transparent margin. One unbroken piece, no stitching or central slit. Quiet warm grey ivory; upper right subtly thinner and cooler, lower left slightly thicker with restrained honey undertone. Calm central writing field retaining fine non-repeating scraping, minute follicle traces, membrane texture and gradual intrinsic tone variation. Matte tactile parchment, not shiny leather or fibrous cotton paper. Soft even neutral illumination; only intrinsic material colour and shallow local fold shading. Distinct restrained contour: slight oblique hand-cut top slope and shallow asymmetric upper-left shoulder; mostly straight long sides with tiny natural deviations. One very small short notch 65 percent down right edge, extending inward less than 2 percent of sheet width. Relatively level bottom with sparse discontinuous abrasion. Uneven contact-darkening upper-right and lower-left, clean stretches between worn places, no continuous dark rim. Single main old compression fold across lower blank portion at 76 percent of total height, a broad very shallow nearly horizontal flattened crease, irregular and interrupted, small settled age tone in parts of valley. Upper three quarters free of major creases, no crossing diagonals, central vertical fold, X, folded corners or raised ridges. Edges flat. True RGBA, alpha zero outside complete contour, no painted checkerboard, white or coloured backdrop, table, wall, gradient, vignette, halo, props or cast shadow. Interior continuous, sufficiently opaque for later printing, only delicate local edge transparency. Absolutely no text, letters, pseudo-script, numerals, signature, stamp, seal, ornament, border, illustration, thread, seam, repair. No mould, mildew, foxing-dot carpet, insect-hole pattern, scorch, burned perimeter, antiquing ring, equal four-side damage, glossy highlights, excessive dirt, modern rounded corners. High fidelity quiet, materially convincing parchment cutout, not a generic grunge stationery texture.
prompts.ornament: This miniature depicts a small repaired slit within one continuous sheet of parchment; both sides belong to that same sheet, and stitches keep that single page intact. An original, restrained miniature study for a contemporary keepsake inspired by European medieval manuscript craft. An extremely narrow, gently bending slit in pale aged parchment joined by about seven fine stitches of faded brick-red silk. Each stitch enters a tiny paired hole, disappears to the reverse, returns through the next hole; short crossings rest close to the parchment rather than floating. The two slit ends taper quietly into intact continuous surface. Delicate parchment fibres, a few subtle warm brown ink shadows, minute thread variation show work of hand. Slender vertical composition, generous true transparent space around it, fine sepia drawing and very light tempera-like washes, quiet materially convincing hand-illustrated miniature. Parchment around seam dissolves irregularly into full transparency, no rectangular page or sticker outline. Slim seam, small mended imperfection, never wide wound or torn-open gash. Unique illustration not reproduction of a historical object. No text, letters, glyphs, pseudo-writing, numerals, signatures, seal, border, needle, hand, book, flowers, leaves, seed, river, map, crown, cross, gold, wax, wooden rod, scene, backdrop, background cast shadow, modern product photography, mould, scorch marks. Transparent RGBA output, no checkerboard painted in.
